mintedBy: Bowman-family baseball checklist-gap acquisition (2026-09-21). Diagnosis of a ~300-sale sample of 2026 bowman-chrome-mega-box unbacked sold_comps rows (query by sport/cardYear/setName, single small TOP queries, point-reads against card_catalog by hobbyiqCardId, NEVER cross-partition COUNT/GROUP BY) found 26/300 (8.7%) unbacked, and every one of those 26 was the SAME defect: the source page's own 17-rung Mojo Refractor colour ladder (Sky Blue /499 down to Rose Gold 1/1) is only partially minted onto the mega box's own 268 base card numbers in card_catalog -- e.g. catalog carried BCP-116 only under 'Yellow Mojo Refractor /75' while sales for BCP-116 were 'Green Mojo Refractor'; the ladder is universal per-base-card, not a fixed one-color-per-number assignment. This package expands the full 268-card roster x full 17-rung ladder and keeps only the (cardNumber, parallel) pairs NOT already present in card_catalog (704 pairs already existed and were skipped -- see rowCount vs 268*17=4,556 theoretical max).
rungsMintedNote: The source page also states 'Rose Gold Mojo Refractor 1/1' (rarest rung, 1:42,015 packs); every base card's Rose Gold pair was already present in card_catalog (source ingest-auto-seed / checklistinsider-2026-08-27) before this package, so no new Rose Gold rows appear in this CSV -- confirmed by the dedup pass, not omitted from the ladder.

insertSetPrefixes.reason: Named insert/autograph subsets carry their own rosters and (per the source page) their own Mojo print-run bands distinct from the base ladder; out of scope for this base-ladder package. The diagnosis sample's few insert-prefixed gaps (BST-5, BST-10, BST-4, BMA-TW, BMA-YP, ES-18) are single-digit counts, not systemic, and are left for a follow-up insert-set package.

spellingAudit: Parallel names taken verbatim from the source's own stated ladder (extractLadders() via backend/scripts/scrape-checklistinsider.cjs, 'Base Parallels List & Odds' heading, 17/17 rungs matched with print runs). Cross-checked against card_catalog's own existing bowman-mega spellings for the same colour words (Sky Blue Mojo Refractor, Green Mojo Refractor, etc. already present under source checklistinsider-2026-08-27/hobbymonitor-scraped-2026-08-18) -- identical spelling, no alignment needed.
selectCardsOnlyAudit: No 'select cards only' language found on the source page's Base Parallels List section; the ladder applies to all 268 base numbers per the page's own odds table (odds stated per pack, not per named card).

provenance.cardsFrom: checklistinsider.com xlsx workbook (tabular-inferred layout via backend/scripts/scrape-checklistinsider.cjs), 268 base cards, unsectioned (this mega-box product's own base run, distinct from the BCP-/BST- inserts that live in flagship 2026 Bowman/Bowman Chrome)
provenance.rungsFrom: the source page's own stated 'Base Parallels List & Odds' heading, verbatim, all 17 rungs with print runs
provenance.dedup: existing card_catalog rows for setKey=bowman-mega, sport=baseball, cardYear=2026 were read via a bounded point-read/query pass (805 existing rows) and any (cardNumber, parallel) pair already present was excluded from this CSV -- 704 of 4,556 theoretical rows were already covered.
